jsonTools.label: Template Indexer

catalog.title: TEMPLATE INDEXER
catalog.desc: Scans the open template for section headings via the kernel's readStructuralMap, writes ELI_SEC_* Word bookmarks at each section start. Re-upload via Template Manager to persist. Admin-only.
catalog.action: if (window.eli && window.eli.dispatch) window.eli.dispatch('tile', 'app_template_indexer'); else if (typeof showTemplateIndexer === 'function') showTemplateIndexer(); else if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Template Indexer not loaded.', 'error');
